ui.chat.attachments.pending_caption.role: caption under the composer chip row
ui.chat.attachments.pending_caption.note: The chips are staged, not sent. States the composer row is pending so a reader cannot mistake it for a sent file card.

ui.chat.attachments.file_meta.role: type and size line on a file card
ui.chat.attachments.file_meta.tone: machine facts, middle dot separator, no sentence
ui.chat.attachments.file_meta.note: Preserve the separator and both placeholders. type is a short uppercase extension (PDF, MD); size is a formatted byte count.

ui.chat.attachments.file_missing.role: existence verdict on a sent file card
ui.chat.attachments.file_missing.note: Shown when the origin path no longer exists on this machine. The recovery line follows it; this verdict must read as a fact about the original file, not as an error about the message.

ui.chat.attachments.file_retained.role: retained-copy line under the missing verdict
ui.chat.attachments.file_retained.note: Diagnostic detail shown in the recovery line's tooltip, not the default sentence (design round 1, D2). digest is the attachment store content address; do not translate or shorten the placeholder.

ui.chat.attachments.file_unnamed.role: filename fallback on a file card
ui.chat.attachments.file_unnamed.note: Only when a document block carried no filename.

ui.chat.attachments.copy_path.role: accessible name of the copy control beside a sent file path
ui.chat.attachments.copy_path.note: Copies the full absolute path, not the truncated line shown on screen.

ui.chat.attachments.path_copied.role: confirmation for the path copy control
ui.chat.attachments.path_copied.note: Announced politely for two seconds after a successful copy; not a toast.

ui.chat.attachments.file_missing_recover.role: line under the missing verdict when the row has NO store path
ui.chat.attachments.file_missing_recover.note: The origin file is gone. Do not claim a saved copy here: without a store path the card cannot name or copy one (design round 2, D2).

ui.chat.attachments.file_type_unknown.role: type fallback on a file card with no readable extension or MIME subtype
ui.chat.attachments.file_type_unknown.note: Only when neither the filename nor the MIME type names a type.

ui.chat.attachments.copy_saved_path.role: accessible name of the copy control in the missing state
ui.chat.attachments.copy_saved_path.note: Copies the STORE path of the retained copy, not the origin path that no longer exists. Shown only when the row carries a store path.

ui.chat.attachments.saved_path_copied.role: confirmation for the saved-copy copy control
ui.chat.attachments.saved_path_copied.note: Announced politely for two seconds after a successful copy of the retained copy's store path.

ui.chat.attachments.saved_copy_label.role: label on the saved-copy row of a missing file card
ui.chat.attachments.saved_copy_label.note: Introduces the attachment store path of the retained copy, which follows on the same row beside a copy control.

ui.chat.attachments.file_and_copy_missin.tone: Plain, concise product language; preserve placeholders exactly.
ui.chat.attachments.file_and_copy_missin.note: Under 'Moved or deleted' on a sent file card: neither the original file nor the app's retained copy exists any more.
